_comment: Citation for the Deadly Demise X core rule (10e). Mapper parses the integer from BSData infoLink modifier; simulator rolls 1D6 on death, applies X mortals within 6" on a 6.

simulator.deadly_demise.quoted_text: Some models have 'Deadly Demise x' listed in the abilities section of their datasheet. If a model has this ability, then when it is destroyed, roll one D6 before removing it from the battlefield: on a 6, each unit within 6" of the bearer suffers a number of mortal wounds denoted by 'x'.
simulator.deadly_demise.trigger: a model with Deadly Demise X is destroyed; before removing it from the battlefield
simulator.deadly_demise.effect: (approximation) roll 1D6; on a 6, each unit within 6" of the destroyed model suffers X mortal wounds. SwegHammer collapses the codex variants (D3, D6, 2D6, 3D6, D3+3, D6+2, D6+3, D6+6, 2D6+6, integer N) to a fixed integer expected value at mapper time (D3→2, D6→3, 2D6→7, 3D6→10, D3+3→5, D6+2→5, D6+3→6, D6+6→9, 2D6+6→13, N→N) so the runtime sees a single integer; the 1-in-6 trigger rate is preserved. Fractional expected values are rounded down per project convention (e.g. D6+2 = E[D6]+2 = 3.5+2 = 5.5, rounded down to 5; 3D6 = 10.5, rounded down to 10). Affects Knight Castellan, Knight Valiant, all Cerastus Knight chassis (Imperial and Chaos), Knight Tyrant, Baneblade-class super-heavies, Stormsurge, Khorne Lord of Skulls, and others (D6+2/D6+3 family); the four Acastus Knight chassis — Acastus Knight Asterius and Acastus Knight Porphyrion, Imperial and Chaos — plus the Revenant Titan, Warhound Titan, Stompa, Gargantuan Squiggoth, Harridan, Hierophant, and several Legends fortifications and super-heavy fliers (2D6, verbatim BSData value '<modifier type="append" value="2D6" field="name"/>', confirmed against `data/bsdata/cache/Imperium - Imperial Knights - Library.cat.gz` and `data/bsdata/cache/Chaos - Chaos Knights Library.cat.gz` for the Acastus chassis); the Phantom Titan, Reaver Titan, and Warbringer Nemesis Titan (D6+6); the Warlord Titan (2D6+6); the Manta and two Legends fortifications (3D6); and Necrons' Szarekh / The Silent King (BSData value 'D6+3 (Szarekh model only)', a parenthetical model qualifier stripped before parsing, not a distinct dice expression). Mortal wounds route through receive_damage so FNP and Death Guard's Disgustingly Resilient compose; secondary kills from a demise do NOT cascade-trigger their own demise in the same dispatch. The mapper's `_parse_demise_value` (code/bsdata/mapper.py) raises, naming the unit and the unrecognised string, on any Deadly Demise value string not covered above (CLAUDE.md rule 13: fail loud on missing data) — see durability-fidelity audit C (docs/_DURA_AUDIT_C_POINTS_OUT.md divergence 3) for the '2D6' silent-default bug this replaced.
